content.text: Maing KAUN, dahme komw ketin dohkiweisang kiht?
Dahme komw ketin karirihkilahr pein komwi ni at milahr nan apwal?
Aramas suwed kan aklapalapalahr oh wie kalokaloke me semwehmwe kan;
komw kaloweiraildi nan lidip me re wiahda.
Aramas suwed kin aksuweiki eh ineng suwed kan;
aramas noahrok kin lahlahwe oh kin soikala KAUN-O.
Aramas suwed sohte kin nsenohki KAUN-O;
nan eh aklapalap e kin lemeleme me sohte katepen Koht.
Aramas suwed kin pweida ni mehkoaros.
E sohte kak dehdehki sapwellimen Koht kadeik kan;
e kin mwamwahliki eh imwintihti kan.
E kin mengimengloalki ndinda, “I sohte kak sapwungala;
I sohte kak mihla nan apwal.”
Eh koasoi kan kin mi ni koasoi en lahlahwe, likamw oh kamasak;
e kin mwadang ong lokaiahn kailok oh suwed.
E kin rukuruk nan kisin kahnimw kan,
awiawih me sohte dipe kan pwe en kemeirailla.
E kin lipoahroke irail kan me sohte ar mehkot;
e rukuruk wasa rir rasehng laion emen.
E kin awiawih me semwehmwe kan;
e ahpw kin kaloweiraildi nan eh lidip oh tangahkiniraildoaui.
Me lelepek lohdier kan engiengehr nanpwel;
kehlail en aramas suwedo kaloweiraildier.
Aramas suwed kin mengimengloalki ndinda, “Koht sohte kin kupwurohki!
E ketin karirihalahr silangi oh sohte pahn mahsanih ie.”
Maing KAUN, komw ketin kaloke aramas suwed pwuko!
Komw ketin kupwukupwure irail kan me kin lokolok!
Ia duwen aramas suwed men e kak mwamwahliki Koht
oh nda, “Koht sohte pahn kalokei ie?”
Ahpw komw kin ketin mahsanih; komw kin ketin kilelehdi apwal oh lokolok kan
oh kin ketin onopada ahnsou koaros pwe en sewese me paisuwedlahr akan.
Aramas paisuwedlahr akan kin sohpeiong komwi;
komwi kin ketin sewese aramas semwehmwe kan ahnsou koaros.
Komw ketin kauwehla manaman en aramas suwed kan;
kaloke kin irail sapwung kan me re wiadahr
re lao tokedihsang.
KAUN-O me nanmwarki poatopoat.
Irail kan me kin kaudokiong koht teikan
pahn kamwomwomwsang nan sapwellime wehi.
Maing KAUN, komw pahn ketin karonge kapakap en me tikitik kan;
komw pahn ketin kakehlahda nan kapehdirail.
Komw pahn ketin karonge likwer en me toutoulahr akan oh me sepwoupwou kan;
komw pahn ketin kadeikada ar pwung,
pwe aramas me kin mour mwotomwot nin sampah wet en dehr kin kamasak irail kohkohlahte.
